annotations.title: Create an Apple Maps location group

description: Create a location group — the set of a brand’s shops an Apple Maps ad group promotes. TWO KINDS. STATIC takes an explicit locationIds list (from list_apple_ads_locations) and is VALID immediately. DYNAMIC takes rules and maintains itself as the brand opens and closes shops, but starts PENDING while Apple evaluates them — wait for systemStatus VALID before targeting it. A RULE THAT MATCHES NOTHING IS APPLE’S ONE SILENT FAILURE HERE: it returns no error and simply builds a group with groupTotal 0, so adminArea must be the FULL English name ("California", never "CA") and locality must be countryOrRegion|adminArea|locality ("US|New York|Brooklyn", never "Brooklyn") — both shapes are refused here before the group is built. A group SPENDS NOTHING and does not decide who sees the ad or how near they are: it only scopes WHICH shops the ad group promotes, while radius and geo targeting on the ad group decide reach. mapsBrandId and the ad account are locked in permanently at creation. Target it afterwards with create_apple_ads_ad_group(targeting.locationGroupIds) or update_apple_ads_object(level:"adgroup"). Free.

locationIds.description: REQUIRED for STATIC — ids from list_apple_ads_locations.

rules.description: REQUIRED for DYNAMIC. value is a string for EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS and an array for IN/NOT_IN.

field.description: adminArea (full state name, e.g. California), locality (countryOrRegion|adminArea|locality), postalCode or locationId

value.description: string for EQUALS or NOT_EQUALS; array for IN or NOT_IN
